title: Activation-Space Order-Swap Geometry: A Site-Asymmetry Audit
abstract: arXiv:2608.25315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Order-dependent activation statistics are often interpreted as evidence of interaction, but that interpretation can be confounded by where interventions enter the network. We introduce a no-fit site-asymmetry audit. For a twice-differentiable readout, the open-path order-swap decomposes into a canonical additive response measured by single interventions and an antisymmetrized second difference free of first-order and pure self-curvature terms to second order. Across six open-weight language-model families, the single-intervention baseline explains 84.3-97.7 percent of the bracket norm (mean 93.7 percent), while the no-interaction self-curvature term is 1.8-5.2 times larger than the corrected residual in the two families with the plus/minus injection split. translated_title: 激活空间顺序交换几何：一种位点不对称性审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25315v1 公告类型：新 摘要：顺序依赖的激活统计常被解释为相互作用的证据，但这种解释可能因干预进入网络的位置而受到混淆。我们引入了一种无拟合的位点不对称性审计。对于二次可微的读出器，开放路径的顺序交换分解为通过单次干预测量的典型加性响应和反对称化的二阶差分，该差分在二阶项上不含一阶项和纯自曲率项。在六个开源语言模型家族中，单次干预基线解释了括号范数的84.3%-97.7%（平均93.7%），而在具有正负注入分割的两个家族中，无相互作用的自曲率项是校正后残差的1.8-5.2倍。在无混淆提示分割下，校正后残差在六个家族中的三个中清除了通用相互作用零假设，在配置鲁棒性后为六个中的两个。一个已知正例...
tldr: 该论文提出一种无拟合的位点不对称性审计方法，通过顺序交换分解表明单次干预基线主导激活统计，而相互作用残差在多数语言模型中不显著。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a no-fit site-asymmetry audit showing that single-intervention baselines dominate activation statistics, with interaction residuals being non-significant in most language models.
